ROOT.scriptdef: if exists(select name from sysobjects where name='PozycjeHPRzZS' and type='IF') drop function CDN.PozycjeHPRzZS

-- CREATE FUNCTION CDN.PozycjeHPRzZS (@ZaNGidNumer int) RETURNS Table as return
select Ptz_TwrNumer TwrNumer, Ptz_Ilosc Ilosc from Cdn.ZamNag inner join Cdn.DokZwiazane on DOZ_DOKNumer = Zan_GidNumer and Doz_DokTyp = Zan_Gidtyp inner join Cdn.ProdTechnologia on PTE_ZrdTyp = 960 and PTE_ZrdNumer = DoZ_ZRDNumer and Pte_ZrdTyp = Doz_ZrdTyp inner join Cdn.ProdTechnologiaCzynnosci on PTC_Technologia = PTE_ID inner join Cdn.ProdTechnologiaZasoby on PTZ_TechnologiaCzynnosc = PTC_ID inner join Cdn.ZamElem ON ZaN_GIDNumer = ZaE_GIDNumer AND PTZ_TwrNumer = ZaE_TwrNumer AND PTZ_TwrTyp = ZaE_TwrTyp where Zan_GidNumer = @ZaNGidNumer and PTZ_TypZasobu = 0 and ( PTZ_ID not in ( select T.PtzID from Cdn.ZamNag inner join Cdn.DokZwiazane on DOZ_DOKNumer = Zan_GidNumer and Doz_DokTyp = Zan_Gidtyp inner join Cdn.ProdTechnologia on PTE_ZrdTyp = 960 and PTE_ZrdNumer = DoZ_ZRDNumer and Pte_ZrdTyp = Doz_ZrdTyp inner join Cdn.ProdTechnologiaCzynnosci on PTC_Technologia = PTE_ID inner join ( SELECT zrodloPolproduktu.PTZ_Id PtzID, zrodloPolproduktu.PTZ_TechnologiaCzynnosc PTZ_Technologia FROM CDN.ProdTechnologiaZasoby ptz INNER JOIN CDN.ProdTechnologiaCzynnosci c ON ptz.PTZ_TechnologiaCzynnosc = c.PTC_Id INNER JOIN CDN.ProdTechnologiaZasoby polprodukty ON polprodukty.PTZ_Id IN (SELECT PTZ_Id FROM CDN.ProdTechnologiaZasoby WHERE PTZ_TechnologiaCzynnosc = c.PTC_Id) AND polprodukty.PTZ_TechnologiaZasob <> 0 INNER JOIN CDN.ProdTechnologiaZasoby zrodloPolproduktu ON zrodloPolproduktu.PTZ_Id = polprodukty.PTZ_TechnologiaZasob WHERE ptz.PTZ_TwrNumer IN (SELECT ZaE_TwrNumer FROM Cdn.ZamElem WHERE ZaE_GidNumer = @ZaNGidNumer) AND c.PTC_Technologia = PTE_Id AND ptz.PTZ_TypZasobu = 0 ) T on T.PTZ_Technologia = PTC_ID where Zan_GidNumer = @ZaNGidNumer))
grant select on CDN.PozycjeHPRzZS to CDNRaport
